content: Isaye ek zormo anda manušore aram goijje
Isa aṛi zat maze hibaye ek zormo anda manušore deikke.
Toi sahabi okkole hibare fusar goijje, hodde "Rabbi, guna hone goijjede, hite nize ne naki hitar ma bafe, ze hitattu anda zormo owa foijje?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Guna no ite goijje, otóba hitar ma bafe; kintu iyan oiye zene hitar butore Allar ham forhaš oi fare.
Din zetun ase hetun, ze ãre defeṛaiye, hibar ham ãra gora iyan zoruri. Rait aiyer, zẽtte honokiye ham gori no faribo.
Ãi zetodin duniyait asi, ãi oilamde duniyair nur."

content: Ei hota hoiyore, hibaye meṛit sep felaiyore hodun fũṭ goijje edde hin manušwar sukot lagai diye.
Tarfore hodde,
(ziyanor mani gorile "defeṛa oiye" o). Toi hite zaiyore dúifelaiye, edde suke dekat maze firi aišše.
Ḍengór bam gójja okkol edde aro zara hite boiyore horat magitode dekkil, hitara hodde, "Ite no neki ze boiyore horat magitode?"
Kiye kiye, oi iba hite hoiye. Ar kiye hodde, "No, hitare saite hendilla lagedde" Kintu manušwaye nize hodde, "Oi, ãi hiba."
Hitara fusar goredde, "Kintu tor suk kengori kuli giyegoi?"
Hite zuwabe hodde, "Isa name manušwaye hodun fũṭ banaiye edde ãr sukor uwore lifidiye, ar ãre hodde, Šiloam foirot za, dúifelagoi; ãi zaiyore zehon dúifelaiyi, toi ãi deki faijji."
Hitara hodde, "hiba hoṛe?" Hite hodde, "Ãi no zani."
Toi hitara he anda aššilde manušware Foroši okkolor hãse loigiye.
Ze din Isaye fũṭ banaiyore manušwar suk kulidiye hedin aššilde Šabbat.
Hetolla Foroši okkole o hitattu fusar goijje, hite deki kengori faijje. Hite hitarare hodde: "Hibaye ãr sukgunor uwore fũṭ lifidiye, ar ãi duifelaiyi, toi ãi dekir."

Foroši hoekzone hodde, "Ei manušwa Allar hãsottu nu aiye, kiyollahoile hite Šabbat falon no gore." Ar kiye hodde, "Ekzon gunagar manuše kengori endilla sinnor ham gori fare?" Ei bafe hitarar butore baga bagi oiye.
Toi hitara he anda aššilde manušwattu abar fusar goijje, "Tui hitar babute ki hos, kiyollahoile hite to tor suk kuli diye" Manušwaye hodde, "Hiba ekzon nobi."
Ihudi okkole kintu manušwar baf mare ḍaki ani fusar no gore foijjonto hitara biššaš gori no faijjil ze hite age anda aššil, ar ehon deker.
Hitara manušwar baf mare fusar goijje, "Ite ki tũwarar he fut, ze anda zormo oiye boli tũwara ho? Ehon hite kengori deki farer?"
Hitar ma bafe zuwab diye, "Ãra zani iba ãrar fut, ar ite anda zormo oiye.
Kintu ehon hite kengori deki farer hiyan ãra no zani. Ar iyano no zani hiba honnuwa, ze hitar suk kuli diye. Hitattu boyoš oiye, hitattu fusar goro. Hite nizor babute nize hok."
Hitar baf maye Ihudi neta okkolor ḍore in okkol hoiye, kiyollahoile Ihudi neta okkol beggune razi aššil ze, ze kiye Isare Messiyah šikar gore, hitare sinagogottu niyolai diya oibo.
Iyanor zoriya hitar baf maye hoiye, "Hitar boyoš oiye, hitare fusar goro."
Anda aššilde manušware dusorabar ḍaikke edde hitare hodde, "Tui soiyi hoiyore Allare tarif de. Ãra to zani ze ei manušwa gunagar."
Hite hodde, "Hiba gunagar ne naki no ãi no zani, kintu ãi iyan zani ze, ãi age anda aššilam ar ehon ãi dekir!"
Toi hitara fusar goijje, "Hite tore ki goijje? Tor suk hite kengori kuli diye?"
Hite zuwab diye, "Ãi to tũwarare age hoiyi, kintu tũwara no funo. Toile tũwara abar kiyolla fuinto sor? Tũwara o ki hibar biššaši oito sor neki?"
Henot hitara hitare kub gozgozaiye edde hodde, "Tui hitar biššaši, kintu ãra Musar biššaši.
Ãra zani ze Allaye Musa loi hota hoiye, kintu ite hontu aišše hiyan ãra no zani."
Manušwaye hitarare zuwab diye, "Iyan ekkan ki tajjuiffa ze hiba hontu tũwara no zano, otoso hibaye ãr suk kuli diye.
Ãra zani ze Allaye gunagarore no fune, kintu hite zodi Allah bokto o, ar hibar issa falon gore, hibaye hitare fune.
Duniyai sirišti oiye loti iyan endilla honodin funa no za ze, honokiye zórmottu loti anda mainšor suk kuli diye.
Hiba zodi Allattu no aito, toile hibaye kissu gori no farito."
Hitara hodde, "Tor zormo ekkubare gunar butore oiyore, ar ãrare šikka dor!" Bade hitara hitare baire niyolai diye.
Isaye fuinne ze, hitara manušware bair gori diye, ar hibaye hitare tuwai faiyore hodde,

content.text: "Tui ki Adomor Futore biššaš goros ne?"

content: Hite zuwab diye, "Malik, hiba honnuwa? Toi zene ãi hibare biššaš gori fari."
Toi Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Tui hibare dekor, ar hibaye tor loi hota hor."

content: Hetunot he manušwaye hodde, "Malik, ãi biššaš gori" ar hite hibare soida goijje.
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Bisarolla ãi ei duniyait aišši, zene zara anda hitara deke, ar zara deke hitara anda o."

content: Foroši okkolor butottu zara hibar fũwati aiššil hitara in okkol fuinne, toi hitara hibare hodde, "Ãra o ki anda neki?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara zodi anda oita, toile tũwarattu hono guna no takito; kintu ehon tũwara hor, 'Ãra dekir,' Hetolla tũwarar guna taki giyegoi."
